claims.claim: NASDAQ ISRG / CIK 0001035267 identity and tradability are validated; operating, annual and governance evidence is primary/SEC and valuation is independent market data.
Current evidence establishes strong procedure and installed-base growth, rising da Vinci 5 placements, recurring instruments/accessories/service economics and substantial cash/investments.
FY2025 10-K documents sole/single-source component exposure, rare-earth/trade risks and manufacturing complexity; 2026 proxy reports strong board independence.

thesisQuality.basis: Large installed base, sustained procedure growth, recurring revenue and workflow integration demonstrate exceptional adoption/value capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Strong procedure/revenue/profit growth and substantial cash/investments support exceptional funding and execution capacity.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: A $140.71b market cap at premium earnings multiples prices substantial growth, leaving balanced upside/downside headroom.

catalystScore.basis: da Vinci 5 placement/utilization growth and procedure expansion provide multiple identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: 8/10 nominees independent, lead independent director, separate Executive Chair/CEO and independent committees support strong oversight.

alignment2036.basis: Robotic-assisted minimally invasive care and connected digital workflows address durable healthcare productivity and clinical needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Systems, instruments/accessories, service, learning and digital capabilities reinforce multiple specialties and recurring utilization economics.

bottleneckControl.basis: Installed-base scale, trained workflows, regulatory qualification and proprietary instruments/service create unusually high switching costs.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Broad procedures, geographies and recurring utilization reduce reliance on individual placements.

substitutionResilience.basis: Workflow integration, clinician training, installed base and proprietary consumables make replacement difficult.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Scale and mitigation capabilities support continuity, but sole/single-source components and rare-earth/trade exposure remain.

pricingPower.basis: Recurring proprietary instruments/accessories/service and strong profitability indicate durable value capture.

riskEvidence.basis: Premium valuation, tariffs, sole/single-source components, reimbursement/access and competition are key risks; balance-sheet risk is low.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current operating, audited annual, proxy governance and independent valuation evidence cover all 12 components.

scoreRecord.thesis: Intuitive combines exceptional robotic-surgery adoption, recurring utilization economics, switching friction and financial strength; premium valuation and supply/access risks are principal offsets.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Premium valuation leaves limited tolerance for procedure deceleration, margin pressure or competitive share loss.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Continued da Vinci 5 placement/utilization conversion and procedure-growth execution.

risks.risk: Premium valuation and supply/access constraints can magnify downside if growth decelerates.

unknowns.unknown: Procedure-level comparative outcomes versus each competing platform remain heterogeneous.
